title: Four test id scanners see only ordinal ids, so their leak and status checks miss every hashed id
body:
Four test-side id scanners recognise only the ordinal shapes, so they see nothing once a project mints git-style ids. Each one writes its own grammar, and none asks the waist (`intentsvcs::id`). Found by vc's Highlander audit of 2026-11-19 (T7). Filed on vc's ruling of 2026-11-20 under hv decision 69. Owner: ic. Rides this release.

## The scanners

1. `intent-cli/src/mcp.rs`, the test `no_tracker_id_reaches_a_published_tool` (about :2542). It scans every published tool's description for this project's own tracker ids: `ST` plus four digits other than `0000`, and `WP-`, `AC-` or `AT-` plus digits.
2. `intent-cli/tests/no_pm_state_in_output.rs`, `pm_identifiers` and `identifier_at` (:117, :138). They scan shipped output for Intent's own project-management ids, with boundary rules of their own. The ids they know are `ST` plus four digits, the `WP-`, `AC-` and `AT-` labels, and the decision series.
3. `intent-cli/tests/register_text_carries_no_maintainer_notes.rs`, `is_dev_id` (:124). It scans user-facing register text for maintainer ids: `AC-`, `AT-`, `INV-` or `WP-` plus a digit, and `TN` plus three digits. It names no thread id at all.
4. `intentsvcs/tests/status_vocabulary.rs`, `is_entity_row` (:345). It recognises a markdown table row whose first cell is an entity, meaning `ST` or `WP-` followed by digits only, so that it can check the status that row renders.

`intentsvcs/tests/address_resolution_single_home.rs:159`, also named in T7, scans for the `intent://` scheme spelled outside its one home. It reads no id, so it is not in this issue.

## The defect

All four accept digits only after the marker. A hashed thread (`ST` plus hex, eg `ST3f9a1c2`), a hashed work package and a hashed issue (`I` plus hex) match none of them:

- Scanners 1 to 3 are leak checks. A hashed id of this project that reaches a published description, a shipped output or a register text passes them. That is the leak D37 names, and it becomes reachable as soon as this repository mints hashed ids after the cut.
- Scanner 4 does not see a hashed record's table row at all. A status rendered wrong on that row is never checked, and the test still passes.

Each check stays green while it asks about nothing. That is the silent form.

## Remedy

Read an id through the waist and stop writing a grammar per test. Each scanner keeps its own subject, meaning what counts as a leak, its boundary rules and its exemptions, such as the zero family `ST0000` and the reader's own id. Whether a word is a thread, package or issue id, of either family, is asked of `intentsvcs::id` (`read_thread`, `read_issue`, `split_wp_address`, or one scanning helper there if they need one). Each scanner gains one control that plants a hashed id and is found.

If writing that up shows a scanner should stay ordinal-only by design, close this issue for that scanner with the reason.
